name: Wand of Detection (traps and secret doors)

system.description:
Detects traps and secret doors with a range of 20 feet. Always active when held, does not use charges.

A plain wand of grey stone, rough to the touch, with a small brass eye mounted near its tip that swivels about of its own accord.
system.unidentifiedDesc: A slim, smoothly finished stick about 18" (45 cm) long, the wand fits comfortably in one hand. Its surface shows faint runes and hairline veins; one end tapers to a rounded tip while the other terminates in a small carved motif. It feels surprisingly light and balanced.
